office: Abbot of the Dormition monastery of Murom on Lake Onega

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Μαρτίου, «Όσιοι Λάζαρος και Αθανάσιος εκ Ρωσίας», with the rank word and the description left off.

The nominative behind the «Афанасия» of days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 8 марта ст. ст., name page 300, «Преподобный Афанасий Мурманский», with the rank word left off; the day's own line declines the name and both by-names, and the title of his own life page adds «Олонецкий» which the name link does not. The shorter form the name link gives is what is stored.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 марта ст. ст. — «Прпп. Лазаря (1391) и Афанасия (XV) Мурманских (Муромских), Олонецких.»

attestations.note: The line is one line for two men and this folder is the second of them. His name page 300 lists this one day and no other, and gives two lives, one of them four sentences of his own and one shared with Lazarus. **The day page prints no hymn under his name**, and the shared life's closing sentence, «известны тропарь и кондак святому», says only that a troparion and a kontakion to him are known; no text of either is printed and none is taken. The folder's `dates` are written from this calendar and are its first.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιοι Λάζαρος και Αθανάσιος εκ Ρωσίας»

attestations.note: The life page, https://www.saint.gr/1246/saint.aspx, has its own «Ημερομηνία Εορτής» of 8 Μαρτίου and «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή», and carries both men; the day's line names Athanasius second and the page heads him first. Of him it says: «Ο Ηγούμενος Αθανάσιος αγωνίστηκε στο μοναστήρι του Οσίου Λαζάρου του Μουρόμ (ή Μούρμανσκ) στα μέσα του 15ου μ.Χ. αιώνα. Δυστυχώς, δεν υπάρχουν πληροφορίες για τη ζωή του.» — unhappily there is no information about his life. It adds that after his repose his body was placed in a chapel of its own and his chains are kept there as evidence of his struggles; that he is venerated locally at Lazarus's monastery together with him; that the veneration is old, and that in the second half of the 17th century the abbot Athanasius is described as «σεβάσμιος θαυματουργός», a venerable wonderworker; that a troparion and a kontakion in his honour are known to exist, neither of which the page prints; and it describes his iconography, the prayer-rope in the left hand and in the right a scroll reading «Άκου, αδελφέ μου, και μην αμαρτάνεις μέχρι το τέλος του αιώνα», and an icon of the two men at the Dormition monastery of Murom in which they stand at full length praying to the Saviour in heaven. The «μέσα του 15ου αιώνα» is a floruit and not a year of birth or of death, so no dates object is written from it.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

floruit.note: The folder's first date, and the Russian calendar is the only one of the four to give it. Its line closes «Афанасия (XV)» — the fifteenth century, which is the interval — and its life for him opens «Подвизался около половины XV века в обители преподобного Лазаря Мурманского (+ 1391 г.)», he laboured about the middle of the fifteenth century in the house of Lazarus of Murom; the shared life says the same, «В середине XV века в обители преподобного Лазаря Мурманского игуменом был преподобный Афанасий». The bounds are the century the line states and the modifier on the display is what the two lives say about where in it he stood, which is the shape `agnes-of-rome` already carries for a late third century inside 201–300; nothing read narrows it further, and no year of birth or of death is printed anywhere.
